signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Welcome back. Sign in to continue.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.description: It takes a moment. You will confirm your email address next.
signUp.sent: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.

unverified.title: Confirm your email address first
unverified.description: Your account is not confirmed yet, so we sent a fresh link to {email}.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.description: Pick a password you have not used here before.
resetPassword.done: Signing in elsewhere has been ended. Use your new password from now on.
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This reset link is no longer valid
resetPassword.invalid: Reset links expire an hour after they are sent. Request a new one.

verifyEmail.confirmed: Your email address is confirmed. Sign in to continue.
verifyEmail.failedTitle: We could not confirm your email address
verifyEmail.failed: That confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Sign in again and we will send you a new one.
verifyEmail.pending: Open the link we emailed you to finish signing in.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: The example feature is a live conversation with the model this deployment configures.

settings.title: Settings
settings.accountEmpty: Your account settings will appear here.
settings.groupEmpty: Your group settings will appear here.

errors.incorrectPassword: That is not your current password.

errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: The name shown to you and to the people you share a group with.

email.title: Email address
email.description: Changing your address takes two links: one from your current inbox to approve the change, then one from the new inbox to complete it.
email.sent: Check {email} — the address you are signed in with — and open the link there. We will then email {newEmail}; opening that second link is what changes your address.
email.linkAccepted: Link accepted. Your account address is the one shown below — if it has not changed yet, open the final link we sent to your new inbox.
email.linkRejected: That link is no longer valid. Start the change again.

password.title: Password
password.description: Choose a new password. You need your current one to make the change.
password.revokeOthersHint: Ends every other session. This device stays signed in.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Where your account is signed in. Revoke anything you do not recognise, then change your password.
sessions.onlyThisDevice: This is the only device signed in to your account.

danger.title: Delete account
danger.description: Deleting your account removes it permanently, along with any group in which you are the only member. This cannot be undone.
danger.sent: Check {email} and open the link to finish deleting your account. Nothing has been deleted yet.
danger.webOnly: Open the link on a device where you are signed in to the web application — the emailed link needs that session to finish.

home.title: AI Starter
home.tagline: A full-stack starter your coding agents can extend.
home.description: Accounts, transactional email, theming, English and Dutch, and a guarded LLM chat — working on web and native before the first line of product code.
home.oauthHint: Add Google or GitHub OAuth credentials to offer social sign-in as well.

chat.title: Ask the assistant
chat.empty: Send a message to start the conversation.
chat.error: The assistant could not answer. Try again.
chat.signInPrompt: Sign in to chat with the assistant.
chat.notConfigured: Chat is not configured. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to enable it.

mobile.apiUnavailable: The API is unavailable. Start the web app and check EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL.
mobile.openLinkOnThisDevice: Open the link on this device to continue in the app.
